schemas.expiries:
CREATE TABLE `expiries` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `licenseID` int(255) NOT NULL,
  `expiry_at` datetime DEFAULT '1000-01-01 00:00:00',
  `startDate` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT '1000-01-01 00:00:00',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=10 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8 COLLATE=utf8_general_ci
schemas.lastedbuys:
CREATE TABLE `lastedbuys` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `userid` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `productid` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `price` int(4) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT '1000-01-01 00:00:00',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=13 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8 COLLATE=utf8_general_ci
schemas.licenses:
CREATE TABLE `licenses` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `row_order` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `productlicenses_id` int(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `userid` int(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `productid` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `domainAdress` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `licenseIP` varchar(255) DEFAULT 'example.com',
  `lastIP` text DEFAULT 'example.com',
  `suspendStatus` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  `totalStart` int(11) DEFAULT 0,
  `mcm-status` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT '1000-01-01 00:00:00',
  `dues` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  `selectedSkin` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `manual_delivery_status` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `smm_order_id` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `smm_progress_percent` tinyint(3) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `smm_progress_text` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `smm_status` varchar(50) DEFAULT NULL,
  `smm_started_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=13 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8 COLLATE=utf8_general_ci
schemas.plugin_servers:
CREATE TABLE `plugin_servers` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `userid` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `row_order` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `name` text NOT NULL,
  `plugin_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `ip` text NOT NULL,
  `port` text NOT NULL,
  `password` text NOT NULL,
  `created_at` date NOT NULL DEFAULT '1000-01-01',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=2 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8 COLLATE=utf8_general_ci
schemas.productcategories:
CREATE TABLE `productcategories` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `userid` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `row_order` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `parentID` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `content` text NOT NULL,
  `slug` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `image_id` char(32) NOT NULL,
  `image_type` varchar(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'jpg',
  `gui` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT '1000-01-01 00:00:00',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=18 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8 COLLATE=utf8_general_ci
schemas.productlicenses:
CREATE TABLE `productlicenses` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `userid` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `productid` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `status` enum('0','1') NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `minecraft` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT '1000-01-01 00:00:00',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=13 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8 COLLATE=utf8_general_ci
schemas.productpackets:
CREATE TABLE `productpackets` (
  `id` int(10) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `category_id` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `userid` int(10) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `name` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `productsStatus` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `products` text NOT NULL,
  `price` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `expiry_at` date DEFAULT '1000-01-01',
  `created_at` date DEFAULT '1000-01-01',
  `row_order` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=4 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_general_ci
schemas.products:
CREATE TABLE `products` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `row_order` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `categoryID` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `name` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `developerID` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `slug` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `init` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `entry` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `image_id` char(32) DEFAULT NULL,
  `image_type` varchar(6) DEFAULT 'jpg',
  `details` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `contents` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `price` int(4) unsigned DEFAULT 0,
  `discountedPrice` int(4) unsigned DEFAULT 0,
  `discountexpiry_at` datetime DEFAULT '1000-01-01 00:00:00',
  `duration` int(4) DEFAULT NULL,
  `stock` int(5) DEFAULT -1,
  `paidFreeStatus` int(11) DEFAULT 0,
  `downloadURL` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `gamemodes` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `fork` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `views` int(11) DEFAULT 0,
  `versions` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `tags` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `videos` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `videosImage` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `discordRole` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime DEFAULT '1000-01-01 00:00:00',
  `productType` varchar(20) DEFAULT 'software',
  `gametype` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `featureComparison` longtext DEFAULT NULL,
  `minecraftData` longtext DEFAULT NULL,
  `stock_type` enum('unlimited','limited') DEFAULT 'unlimited',
  `sale_duration` int(11) DEFAULT 0,
  `required_products` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `require_only_one` tinyint(1) DEFAULT 0,
  `plugin_data` longtext DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Minecraft ürünlerinin sunucu, komut ve özellik yapılarını JSON olarak tutar',
  `skin_data` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `cosmetic_data` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `plugin_features` longtext DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Karşılaştırmalı özellik tablosu',
  `grant_role_ids` longtext CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL DEFAULT json_array(),
  `service_type` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'manual',
  `provider_id` int(10) unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `provider_service_id` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `min_quantity` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `max_quantity` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `variant_ids` longtext DEFAULT NULL,
  `product_questions` longtext DEFAULT NULL,
  `extra_services` longtext DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=64 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8 COLLATE=utf8_general_ci
schemas.userslist:
CREATE TABLE `userslist` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `row_order` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `subname` varchar(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `lastname` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `nick` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `email` varchar(255) DEFAULT 'zonely@gmail.com',
  `password` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `discord_id` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `avatar` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `google_avatar` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `userperms` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `header_background` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `header_background_type` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `avatar_background` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `avatar_background_type` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `body_background` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `body_background_type` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `lastlogin` datetime DEFAULT '1000-01-01 00:00:00',
  `is_logged` smallint(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `credit` int(5) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `gold` int(255) DEFAULT 0,
  `gift_gold` int(255) DEFAULT 0,
  `tfa_status` enum('0','1') NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `created_ip` varchar(40) NOT NULL DEFAULT '127.0.0.1',
  `linkvertise_gold` int(255) DEFAULT 0,
  `hwid` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT '1000-01-01 00:00:00',
  `cfxre_id` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `cfxre_username` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `roblox_username` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `roblox_id` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `steam_id` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `realsubname` text DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=5 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8 COLLATE=utf8_general_ci
